arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-02' AND date < '2019-11-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions from 2 October to 31 October 2019, the last 30 days of the data with the most recent day included.
assumptions: Relative to the last day of the data, 2019-10-31, not today's date.
The 30-day window is 2019-10-02 through 2019-10-31 inclusive, so 31 October counts as day one of 30.
Counts all transactions whether or not they have a fraud label, since the question asks for total transactions.
Includes transactions with negative amounts; they are counted as transactions.
